# Laptop loan scheme

- Short loan (up to 5 working days): approved by the IT desk the same day.
- Standard loan (6-30 days): needs line manager approval; deposit 200.
- Long loan (31-90 days): needs department head approval; deposit 500.
- Loans over 90 days are not available; request a permanent device instead.
- Late return: 15 per day after the due date, charged against the deposit.
- Damage: repair costs above 100 are deducted from the deposit.

turns.prompt: I need a laptop for 45 days for a field project. Who has to approve it and how much deposit do I pay?
